builder.name: Anna: first conversation (lead from Instagram reel)

situation.scenario: The learner speaks with Anna, who came in as a lead from: Instagram reel. Lives in a rental; clicked a reel about 'best deals in JLT'. Curious but non-committal. Wants to see what’s out there with minimal effort. Budget unknown; maybe up to 1.2M AED; timeline no deadline.
situation.hiddenTruth:
Held back until the learner earns it:
• Motivation: low
• What matters most: Time constraints 40%; Best price 35%; Market conditions 25%
• Constraints: busy schedule; wants WhatsApp options first; doesn’t want mortgage hassle
• Areas: JLT or Dubai Marina (if nudged)
situation.agreesWhen: The learner offers: questions about why moving matters; time-efficient next steps.
situation.declinesWhen: The learner uses: hard close; price-only pitch.

builder.whatToExpect: A first call with Anna (JLT window-shopper), who came in from: Instagram reel. Earn the details before you pitch. Goal: agree to share rough budget and a short follow-up call.
builder.opening: Hi, yeah, I clicked on that reel about JLT deals. I'm kind of busy, can you just send me some options?
exampleLines: I don't really have a budget yet.
Sorry, I've only got a minute.
I'm happy renting for now, I was just curious.
learnerGoals: Agree to share rough budget and a short follow-up call

rubric.name: Opened the client up: used the openness triggers
Avoided shutdown triggers and pet peeves
Covered what matters most, in proportion: Time constraints 40%, Best price 35%, Market conditions 25%
Secured the goal's next step with a date
